title: Payment Configuration
description: Learn how to configure payment gateways, set up payment methods, and manage payment settings for your store.
content:
Payment Configuration

Configure payment gateways and methods to accept payments from customers worldwide. Tijraa supports 27+ payment gateways.

Accessing Payment Settings

Navigate to Settings → Payment Gateways to configure payment methods for your store.

Supported Payment Gateways

Tijraa supports the following payment gateways:

  • Stripe
  • PayPal
  • Razorpay
  • MercadoPago
  • Paystack
  • Flutterwave
  • PayTabs
  • Bank Transfer
  • Skrill
  • CoinGate (Cryptocurrency)
  • PayFast
  • Mollie
  • ToyyibPay
  • Iyzipay
  • Benefit
  • Ozow
  • Easebuzz
  • Khalti
  • Authorize.Net
  • FedaPay
  • PayHere
  • CinetPay
  • Paiement
  • Nepalste
  • YooKassa
  • Aamarpay
  • Midtrans
  • PaymentWall
  • SSPay
  • Cashfree
  • Tap
  • PayTR
  • Xendit

Configuring a Payment Gateway

Step 1: Select Gateway

Choose the payment gateway you want to configure from the list.

Step 2: Enable Gateway

Toggle the gateway to "Enabled" status.

Step 3: Enter Credentials

Provide required credentials:

  • API keys
  • Secret keys
  • Merchant ID
  • Webhook URLs (auto-generated)

Step 4: Configure Settings

Set additional settings:

  • Test mode (for testing)
  • Production mode (for live payments)
  • Currency support
  • Payment methods
  • Transaction fees

Step 5: Test Configuration

Test the configuration using test mode before going live.

Payment Methods

Configure which payment methods to accept:

  • Credit/Debit cards
  • Bank transfer
  • Digital wallets
  • Cryptocurrency
  • Cash on delivery
  • Buy now, pay later

Currency Configuration

Set up currency settings:

  • Store currency
  • Supported currencies per gateway
  • Currency conversion
  • Multi-currency support

Payment Processing

Configure processing options:

  • Automatic payment capture
  • Manual payment approval
  • Payment hold for review
  • Partial payment acceptance

Security Settings

Payment security features:

  • SSL/TLS encryption
  • PCI compliance
  • 3D Secure authentication
  • Fraud detection
  • Transaction verification

Webhooks Configuration

Configure webhooks for payment notifications:

  • Payment success webhooks
  • Payment failure webhooks
  • Refund webhooks
  • Automatic order updates

Testing Payments

Test payments before going live:

  • Use test mode
  • Use test cards
  • Verify webhooks
  • Test all payment methods
  • Test refunds

Best Practices

  • Enable multiple payment methods
  • Test thoroughly before going live
  • Keep credentials secure
  • Monitor transactions regularly
  • Enable fraud protection
  • Set up proper webhooks
  • Use SSL certificates
